status.description: success = goal achieved; incomplete = ran out of steps without confirming completion; failed = hard failure; credentials_needed = login required but no vault credentials were provisioned.

answer.description: Final answer extracted from the run's saved notes (empty when status is credentials_needed or failed).

run_dir.description: Run artifacts directory (screenshots, steps.jsonl debug log).

site.description: URL or domain where login blocked the goal.

stop_reason.description: Why the run ended when status is not success. 'step_budget_exhausted' means it reached its step ceiling with work still outstanding — the answer and artifacts are partial, not final.

paused_sec.description: Seconds this run spent parked while a human drove the browser. Excluded from the agent's own time budget.

takeovers.description: Every time a human paused the run and drove the browser themselves. The page state after one is their work, not the agent's - read the summary before assuming the agent did it.

new_origins.description: Sites the human gained signed-in state for during the takeover.

step_extensions.description: Every time the run reached its step ceiling and asked to continue, with the decision and why. Granted only when recent steps showed verified progress.

artifacts.description: Long extracts the run offloaded to its own note store, saved as readable files. When `answer` summarizes or points at one of these, load it with artifact_read using the entry's `path` before answering from the summary alone.

path.description: Logical path to pass to artifact_read.

note_id.description: The run's internal note id this file came from.

contains.description: One-line description of what was offloaded.

user_interrupts.description: Every AskUser question raised mid-run and its outcome, for post-hoc visibility only — these were resolved directly between the browser agent and the desktop, not by the orchestrator. Answers to password/verification_code questions are never included, only whether one was provided.

answer.description: Present only for non-secret kinds (confirm/blocked/generic) that were answered; truncated to 200 chars.
